look_here_first: Small annual milkvetch with pink-purple flowers and very narrow straight pods that split lengthwise when mature.

key_traits.label: Family pattern
key_traits.text: Fabaceae/Astragalus: alternate pinnate leaves, papilionoid pea flowers, and legumes; fruit shape, inflation, hairiness, and curvature are especially useful for species ID.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: small pink to purple pea flowers

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: fruit proportionally much longer than wide

lookalikes.differences: Think narrowest fruit in the batch. It lacks the thick groundplum pod and differs from Nuttall's milkvetch by its especially slim straight legumes.
